import json

def find(name):
    return execute_tool('editor_toolset.toolsets.scene.SceneTools.find_actors', json.dumps({'name': name, 'tag': '', 'collision_channels': []}))['returnValue']

def add(class_path, name, x, y, z):
    existing = find(name)
    if existing: return existing[0]
    return execute_tool('editor_toolset.toolsets.scene.SceneTools.add_to_scene_from_class', json.dumps({'actor_type': {'refPath': class_path}, 'name': name, 'xform': {'location': {'x': x, 'y': y, 'z': z}}, 'snap_to_ground': True}))['returnValue']

def setv(obj, values):
    if not execute_tool('editor_toolset.toolsets.object.ObjectTools.set_properties', json.dumps({'instance': obj, 'values': json.dumps(values)}))['returnValue']:
        raise RuntimeError('set failed: ' + str(obj))

def folder(actor, path):
    execute_tool('editor_toolset.toolsets.scene.SceneTools.set_actor_folder', json.dumps({'actor': actor, 'folder_path': path}))

def run():
    terminal_class = '/ExtractionOps/World/Terminals/B_SignalTerminal.B_SignalTerminal_C'
    zone_class = '/ExtractionOps/World/Extraction/B_ExtractionZone.B_ExtractionZone_C'
    loot_class = '/ExtractionOps/World/Loot/B_ExtractionLootContainer.B_ExtractionLootContainer_C'
    actors = []
    terminals = [
      ('SignalTerminal_A','Terminal_A',-650,-100,160),
      ('SignalTerminal_B','Terminal_B',950,-1750,150),
      ('SignalTerminal_C','Terminal_C',1150,1650,150)]
    for name, ident, x, y, z in terminals:
        actor = add(terminal_class,name,x,y,z); setv(actor,{'terminalId':ident,'bIsSpatiallyLoaded':False}); folder(actor,'ExtractionOps/Terminals'); actors.append(actor)
    zones = [('ExtractionZone_A','Extraction_A',-2050,150,150),('ExtractionZone_B','Extraction_B',2000,150,150)]
    for name, ident, x, y, z in zones:
        actor=add(zone_class,name,x,y,z); setv(actor,{'zoneId':ident,'bIsSpatiallyLoaded':False}); folder(actor,'ExtractionOps/Extraction'); actors.append(actor)
    loot = [
      ('LootZone_A',-900,-1700,150,['/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Valuable_ScrapMetal.DA_Valuable_ScrapMetal','/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Ammo_Rifle.DA_Ammo_Rifle']),
      ('LootZone_B',900,-1700,150,['/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Valuable_PowerCell.DA_Valuable_PowerCell','/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Item_Medkit.DA_Item_Medkit']),
      ('LootZone_C',-1100,1600,150,['/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Valuable_OpticModule.DA_Valuable_OpticModule','/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Ammo_Shells.DA_Ammo_Shells']),
      ('LootZone_D',1100,1600,150,['/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Valuable_EncryptedDrive.DA_Valuable_EncryptedDrive','/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Valuable_ServoMotor.DA_Valuable_ServoMotor']),
      ('HighRiskLandmark',0,300,150,['/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Valuable_ReactorCore.DA_Valuable_ReactorCore','/ExtractionOps/Items/DA_Valuable_PrototypeChip.DA_Valuable_PrototypeChip'])]
    for name,x,y,z,defs in loot:
        actor=add(loot_class,name,x,y,z); setv(actor,{'initialDefinitions':[{'refPath':d} for d in defs],'initialQuantityPerDefinition':1,'bIsSpatiallyLoaded':False}); folder(actor,'ExtractionOps/HighRisk' if name=='HighRiskLandmark' else 'ExtractionOps/Loot'); actors.append(actor)
    if not execute_tool('editor_toolset.toolsets.asset.AssetTools.save_assets', json.dumps({'asset_paths':['/ExtractionOps/Maps/L_ExtractionTest']}))['returnValue']:
        raise RuntimeError('map save failed')
    return {'actorCount':len(actors),'terminals':3,'extractionZones':2,'lootAreas':4,'highRiskLandmarks':1,'spatiallyLoadedActors':0}
